findings.finding: Gain changes require observation of tracking, overshoot and noise response. This motivates a fixed simulation experiment, not adoption of numerical gains from another controller.
findings.confidence: High for the need to measure tradeoffs; numeric gain hypothesis unvalidated
findings.relevance: AL-025 found horizontal displacement already present at first contact on stress seeds 401 and 503
findings.direction_alignment: Evaluate horizontal approach control with unchanged physics and original gates
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Higher gains can trade lower tracking error for greater effort or regressions
findings.engineering_cost: Opt-in schedule, strict recording/live contracts, 24 new final flights, ten-feature demo
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-026 predeclares scheduled approach gains and paired evaluation
findings.verification_needed: Fixed source and seed cohorts, pre-ramp identity, every original gate, live and 3D demonstration

overall_recommendation: Measure one frozen horizontal gain schedule across regression, known stress and predeclared additional seeds; preserve default and failed trials.
evidence_gaps: No numeric gain validation before the experiment
Ideal attitude/contact supervision and open AL-010 yaw refinement
